entry.excerpt: The Secretary of State was asked—

subs.body: 2025 Budget
subs.excerpt: What recent discussions she has had with the Welsh Government on the potential impact of the Budget 2025 on Wales.

subs.body: Economic Growth
subs.excerpt: What recent discussions she has had with Cabinet colleagues on increasing economic growth in Wales.

subs.body: Grooming Gangs
subs.excerpt: What steps she is taking with the Home Secretary to help tackle grooming gangs in Wales.

subs.body: Job Creation: Wales
subs.excerpt: What steps she is taking with Cabinet colleagues to help create new jobs in Wales.

subs.body: Visitor Levy: Wales
subs.excerpt: Whether she has had discussions with the Welsh Government on the potential impact of the proposed visitor levy on the Welsh economy.

subs.body: Engagements
subs.excerpt: If he will list his official engagements for Wednesday 3 December.
